name: Workplace: creative studio
about: A design, architecture, media or advertising studio: one open studio with room to pin up and review, a materials library, a workshop for models, edit and sound rooms that want no window, a gallery at the front. In three parts: the Workplace: creative studio typology (on the Workplace one), an office fit-out on an RCC shell, and the BuilderPluss standards with the Indian codes. 2.2.0: its glazed walls in the versions that say they let light through (R160); nothing else changed.
